A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same SAM 3D work. Their complete text, equations, tables, figures, and appendices A–F support reliable comparison, including matching relocated and renumbered material.

before.justification: V1 reports original reconstruction scores, human-preference evaluations, and ablations in Section 4 and Appendix E, including experiments on SA-3DAO, ISO3D, and Aria Digital Twin.

after.justification: V2 retains those original empirical results and adds qualitative input-mask robustness examples in Appendix E.9.

M1.justification: The architecture, data engine, flow-matching and DPO objectives, Depth-VAE, and shortcut distillation remain unchanged. Table 1's added Flying Occlusions marker matches texture-training data already documented in v1's Section C.5 and Table 6.

E1.justification: Appendix E.9 and Figure 20 add explicit testing with over-segmented and under-segmented input masks. This extends evaluated input conditions beyond the previously reported mask-augmentation training ablation; the training datasets and established benchmarks remain unchanged.

E2.justification: The comparator sets in Tables 2, 3, and 8 and their corresponding figures are retained, including the shape generators, pose-estimation pipelines, MIDI, and Unitex. Newly cited related works are not added as evaluated baselines.

E3.justification: The new mask study adds a two-case qualitative testing procedure showing imprecise masks and resulting reconstructions. It specifies no quantitative perturbation sweep or robustness metric. Existing benchmark preprocessing, metrics, sample sizes, training budgets, and preference-evaluation procedures remain unchanged.

E4.justification: New Appendix E.9 examines sensitivity to input-mask precision through an over-segmented plant and an under-segmented sofa. Existing training-stage, texture, rotation, pointmap, Depth-VAE, reward-search, and distillation analyses are retained.

E5.justification: Run and seed information and statistical reporting practices are unchanged. The VLM, DPO, and human agreement figures in E.7 are retained; the added footnote explains disagreement rather than introducing uncertainty estimation or additional measurements.

E6.justification: Figure 20 adds qualitative reconstruction results under mask errors. Section C.2 also newly reports an unquantified observation that geometric losses become less useful as data and compute increase. Existing numerical results and plotted trends are unchanged, including Table 2's SAM 3D F1 of 0.2344 and Chamfer distance of 0.0400.

T1.justification: The mathematical definitions, derivations, and algorithms are retained. Equation 4 changes the sampling notation from q(x) to p(x), matching v1's accompanying definition of a real data sample; this corrects notation without changing the stated mathematical procedure.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain the same contributions: single-image shape, texture, and layout reconstruction; the annotation engine; multistage training; and SA-3DAO. The principal performance claims, including at least a 5:1 human-preference win rate, are unchanged.

C2.justification: V2 adds interpretations concerning implicitly learned geometric priors at scale, disagreement between annotators, and tolerance of mask errors. Appendix F explicitly adds thin structures to resolution limitations and discusses potential scene-level inference efficiency.

D1.justification: Section 4 adds a direct SA-3DAO dataset access link. Implementation details, hardware, training schedules, hyperparameters, and the code link are retained. Table 1's corrected training-data marker reconciles its summary with information already present in v1's appendix.

R1.justification: Section 5 expands the existing discussion with model-based versus model-free scene reconstruction, amodal completion, and procedural datasets, citing works such as CAD-Estate, RayTran, CAST, Amodal3R, and Infinigen Indoors. This refines SAM 3D's positioning while retaining its central research framing.

P1.justification: V2 makes localized related-work rewrites, adds the E.9 subsection and explanatory passages, and corrects wording and typographical errors. The overall narrative and main-text/appendix organization remain substantially the same.

P2.justification: V2 adds the mask-robustness Figure 20, relocates v1's distillation Figure 21 as Figure 19, and renumbers the retained qualitative galleries. It also adjusts the Figure 12 UI display and wraps text around Figure 16. Existing quantitative displays retain their content.

improvement.justification: V2 provides useful mask-error examples, clearer research positioning and limitations, and a direct benchmark access link while preserving the existing evidence. These improve practical understanding and clarity. The robustness addition comprises only two qualitative cases, and the new scaling interpretation lacks quantified support, so the overall gain is limited.
